Norman sat down on his recliner and sighed, turning on the TV to watch CSI. It had been a long day of work and he was glad to finally relax. Norman was at his feet grooming, then scurried away when, suddenly, Norman stood up. "Where is my wallet?" Norman exclaimed, as he realized the normal lump in his back pocket was missing. He could have dropped it in the parking lot. He could have left it in his desk at work. After searching his office complex parking lot, Norman had to ask the night security guard to let him in. Since his employee ID was in his wallet, he had to call up his manager to verify his employment with the company. Norman felt very glad that his manager and the guard offered to help him. They searched all over the office, but, alas, the search yielded no results. Suddenly, Norman began to turn red. He remembered putting his wallet down on his kitchen counter when he got home. Feeling embarrassed, Norman decided not to say anything. After an hour of searching, he told his manager and the guard thank you and they expressed their genuine sympathy for his conundrum. Norman went home and saw his wallet on the kitchen counter. Feeling guilty, he decided to grab two TV dinners from the freezer tonight.
